description: Saves one design file you wrote into the folder use_open_design_managed_workspace opened, exactly as given, and returns its path, size and SHA-256. Only works in that folder: anywhere else, write files with your own file-editing tools. Pass the whole file each time (to edit, send the full new version). path is workspace-relative and must be under the output directory, e.g. ".open-design/coffee-poster/coffee-poster.html". Allowed: .html .htm .css .js .mjs .json .svg .md .txt .csv as text, and .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .woff .woff2 as base64 with encoding "base64"; at most 5 MiB. Manifests, comments, config.json, exports/ and check screenshots belong to other tools and are refused. Never deletes or moves anything. After writing an entry file, call register_open_design_artifact as usual.

content.description: The whole file: text, or base64 for images and fonts.

encoding.description: Set to "base64" for images and fonts. Leave out for text.

path.description: Workspace-relative path under the output directory, e.g. ".open-design/coffee-poster/coffee-poster.html".

name: write_open_design_file
